## Help Send Mike to Congress
Kathy Castor has spent 18 years in Congress turning a taxpayer-funded salary into a personal fortune while Tampa Bay families struggle with skyrocketing costs. It's time for a champion who will actually fight for us.
## Tampa Bay's Fighter for Opportunity and Lower Costs
- ✓ Loving Husband & Father
- ✓ Champion for Healthcare Access & Affordability
- ✓ Fighter for the People Against Politicians
Mike Beltran grew up in Brooklyn, New York. After graduating from Harvard Law at the height of the Great Recession, Mike moved to Florida like so many others looking for opportunity. After years of serving his community as a lawyer, Mike felt called to public service and served for six years in the Florida House of Representatives. In the legislature, Mike made a name for himself as someone who stood his ground against both parties, refusing to go along with a bad idea just because his party suggested it.
In just six years, Mike helped deliver the largest tax cut in Florida history, putting money back in the pockets of Tampa Bay families dealing with historic inflation, expanded healthcare access to pave the way for lower costs on prescription drugs and new hospitals and clinics across Florida, while preserving our rights and values.
Now Mike is running for Congress to retire Kathy Castor and be that same champion for lower costs, lower taxes, and increased healthcare access, to ensure Tampa Bay remains the greatest place to live and raise a family in the country.

pages.title: Platform - Mike Beltran for Congress
pages.text:
## Taking the Florida Way to Congress
Mike Beltran delivered solutions in Tallahassee while Kathy Castor made our lives harder and more expensive. Mike has a plan to change that in Congress.
## Lower Healthcare Costs & Expand Access
## Lower the Cost of Living & Keep More of What You Earn
## Grow Jobs & Remove Barriers to Opportunity
## Protect Our Community From Overreach
## A Fighter for Families, Not a Career Politician
## Ban Congressional Stock Trading
Public service should not create opportunities for personal financial gain. From the start, Mike has supported banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks and strengthening transparency and accountability rules to help prevent conflicts of interest and protect public trust. Meanwhile, Rep. Kathy Castor has admitted to individual stock trading with no safeguards.
These rules should apply to everyone, regardless of party. Public service should be about serving the people, and Washington needs clear, enforceable standards that put accountability first.
## Support Our Veterans & Military
The men and women who served this country earned every benefit and every right they were promised. Mike will fight to ensure our veterans receive the care, resources, and respect they deserve. He supports a strong national defense and a military that is focused on protecting America, not advancing political agendas.
## School Choice & Parental Rights
Parents know what is best for their children. Mike championed school choice in Tallahassee, giving families the freedom to choose the school and education that works for them. He'll bring that fight to Washington and stand against any effort to cut parents out of decisions about their children's education and values.
## Secure the Border
Mike stands 100% with President Trump on immigration. We need to finish the wall, deport the criminals and fraudsters, and restore law and order at our southern border. Florida's families deserve security, not an open-border disaster.
## Back Law Enforcement
Our police officers and first responders put themselves on the line every day to keep Tampa Bay safe. Mike stands firmly behind law enforcement and will oppose any effort to defund, undermine, or politicize the men and women who protect our communities.
## Defend the Second Amendment
Mike has a perfect pro-gun record. No red flag laws, no magazine bans, no compromise. The Second Amendment is absolute and Mike will fight to keep it that way in Congress.
## Protect Life
Mike has always fought to protect life. He believes Dobbs was correctly decided and that states, not Washington bureaucrats, judges, or politicians, should set their own policies that include exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother.
## Safeguard Our Elections
Our elections should be the cleanest and most secure in the entire world. We need to pass the SAVE America Act to ensure only American citizens vote in our elections, mandate photo ID, and purge noncitizens from voter rolls. Every American citizen deserves to have their voice heard in our elections, and if we let fraud or illegal votes flood the system, then the voices of Americans are diluted.

pages.title: Privacy Policy - Mike Beltran for Congress
pages.text:
You agree to receive recurring automated informational text (e.g., SMS and MMS) messages from Mike Beltran for Congress, including text messages that may be sent using an automatic telephone dialing system, to the mobile telephone number you provided when signing up or any other number that you designate. Consent to receive automated informational text messages is not a condition of any purchase.
Msg & Data rates may apply. Please consult with your carrier for rate information.
Message frequency will vary. Mike Beltran for Congress reserves the right to alter the frequency of messages sent at any time. Mike Beltran for Congress also reserves the right to change the phone number from which messages are sent. Not all mobile devices or handsets may be supported and our messages may not be deliverable in all areas. Mike Beltran for Congress, its service providers and the mobile carriers supported by the program are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
If you do not wish to continue participating or no longer agree to these Terms, reply to any message with STOP, END, CANCEL, UNSUBSCRIBE, or QUIT to opt out at any time. You may receive an additional message confirming your decision to opt out. You may be subscribed across different numbers and must separately reply STOP to each number from which you wish to unsubscribe.
For support, text “HELP” to the applicable number, or email us at [email protected] . Note that texting “HELP” is not an acceptable method of opting out — opt outs must be submitted per the procedures above.
The Programs are offered on an “as-is” basis and may not be available in all areas at all times. We will not be liable for any delays or failures in the receipt of any mobile messages. Delivery of mobile messages is subject to effective transmission from your wireless service provider and is outside of our control.
We respect your privacy. We will only use information you provide to transmit your mobile messages and respond to you, if necessary. This includes sharing information with our program partners, message content providers, phone companies, and vendors who assist us in the delivery of mobile messages. Collected phone numbers will not be sold to third parties, shared or used for affiliate marketing.
EXCEPT AS SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION, WE DO NOT SELL, RENT, LOAN, TRADE, LEASE OR OTHERWISE TRANSFER FOR PROFIT ANY PHONE NUMBERS OR CUSTOMER INFORMATION COLLECTED THROUGH PROGRAMS TO ANY THIRD PARTY.
We reserve the right at all times to disclose any information as necessary to satisfy any law, regulation or governmental request, to avoid liability, or to protect our rights or property.
When you complete forms online or otherwise provide us information in connection with a Program, you agree to provide accurate, complete, and true information. You agree not to use a false or misleading name or a name that you are not authorized to use.
This Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions is strictly limited to these Programs and has no effect on any other privacy policy(ies) that may govern the relationship between you and us in other contexts.
